sonic.say.gpuHint: The browser is drawing this page on the integrated graphics chip, and this computer most likely has a faster graphics card (NVIDIA or AMD) that the browser leaves unused. The fast card gives more detail and more frames per second. Ask your helper to switch the browser to it: in Chrome open the address chrome://flags, in Edge edge://flags, find Force high performance GPU, choose Enabled and restart the browser.
sonic.say.gpuHintAgain: Reminder: the browser is still drawing this page on the integrated graphics chip. The note on the screen says how to switch, and its button Do not show again stops this reminder.
sonic.say.gpuSoftware: The browser is drawing this page on the processor, not on a graphics card, so everything runs very slowly. Ask your helper to switch graphics acceleration on in the browser's settings and to check that the graphics adapter is enabled and has a driver; in Windows that is Device Manager, Display adapters.
sonic.say.gpuSoftwareAgain: Reminder: the browser is still drawing this page on the processor, not on a graphics card. The note on the screen says what to check, and its button Do not show again stops this reminder.
sonic.say.helpHome: Press {key} to leave the lesson for the main menu. The lesson is saved.
sonic.say.helpPrevious: Press {key} to go back one step.
sonic.say.helpRepeat: Press {key} to hear the task of this step again, with its sounds.
sonic.say.helpCourse: Press {key} for a course of gates in this scene. A new course replaces the old one.
sonic.say.helpShare: Press {key} to copy a link to this lesson, to share it.
sonic.say.homeBack: Main menu of Fly by Sound. The lesson {title} is saved: Continue takes you back to it.
sonic.say.lessonKeys: Next, key {next}. Back, key {previous}. Repeat, key {repeat}. Menu, key {menu}. Main menu, key {home}.
sonic.say.lessonKeysFree: Back, key {previous}. Repeat, key {repeat}. Menu, key {menu}. Main menu, key {home}.
sonic.say.linkCopied: The link to this lesson is copied. Paste it into a message or an e-mail to share it.
sonic.say.linkCopiedStart: The link to Fly by Sound is copied. Paste it into a message or an e-mail to share it.
sonic.say.linkSelected: The link to the lesson {lesson} was not copied. It is selected: press {copy} to copy it, then Escape to go back.
sonic.say.linkSelectedStart: The link to Fly by Sound was not copied. It is selected: press {copy} to copy it, then Escape to go back.
sonic.say.listHelp: Move with the arrows. Choose with key Enter, go back with key Escape.
sonic.say.menuOpen: Lesson menu: arrows move, key Enter chooses, key Escape goes back. The same actions have keys without the menu: each item says its key.
sonic.say.replayOlder: Recorded with lesson version {recorded}; this build has version {here}. You hear the lines as the pilot heard them.
sonic.say.scanFailed: The scan did not load. Check the connection, then choose the lesson again.
sonic.say.scanLoading: Loading the scan; it can take a minute. The lesson starts by itself.
sonic.say.soundBack: The sound was interrupted. Press {key} to hear the task of this step again.
sonic.say.wallsCoarse: The walls of this scan are coarse: about {cm} centimetres at this size. A wall can sound a little nearer or farther than it really is.
sonic.scaleLocked: Fly by Sound: the scene keeps its size during a lesson
sonic.sceneLocked: Fly by Sound: the scene does not change during a lesson
sonic.settings.keyHints: Key hints at the start of each step
sonic.settings.layers: Volume and pitch of each sound
sonic.settings.narratorWhat: Off: sounds only. In a flight nothing is spoken and nothing waits for a line; the lessons keep their words.
sonic.start.heading: Start
sonic.start.intro: Learn to fly a drone by ear: everything is sound, no screen needed. A helper can set up your radio, keyboard or gamepad.
sonic.start.name: Fly by Sound
sonic.start.noAudio: This browser cannot play sound, so Fly by Sound cannot run here. Try a current Chrome or Edge.
sonic.start.engineFailed: Sound did not start in this browser. Open this page in Chrome or Edge, or reload the page and try again.
sonic.start.linkCopied: Link copied. Paste it into Chrome or Edge.
sonic.start.copyFailed: The link was not copied. Copy it from the address bar.
sonic.start.unknown: There is no lesson called {id}. Choose one from the list.
sonic.say.wallsBuilding: Building the walls of this scan now. Fly on by your height; walls come in a minute or two.
sonic.say.wallsIn: The walls are in. Now you hear them too.
sonic.say.wallsFailed: The walls did not come this time. Fly on by your height, or open this scan again.
sonic.say.scanNoWalls: This scan has no walls yet: you hear only your height. Build walls from the simulator's pause menu, then come back by Fly by Sound.
sonic.say.courseOffer: Press {key} for a course of gates in this scan.
sonic.say.courseMaking: Building a course of gates in this scan. It can take half a minute.
sonic.say.courseReady: Course ready, gates: {n}, laps: {laps}; the hum leads to the first gate. {key} gives another course.
sonic.say.courseNone: No course of gates fits in this scan. You fly freely again.
sonic.start.scanWhat: Free flight over this scan at size x{size}, with its walls and your height. No rings, no clock.
sonic.say.helpNarrator: Press {key} to switch the narrator off or on. Off, you fly by sound alone.
sonic.say.helpHead: Press {key} to centre head tracking: face the screen first.
sonic.say.narratorTip: You finished a course by sound. Press {key} to switch the narrator off and fly by sound alone.
sonic.say.lessonNarrator: The narrator is on for this lesson. It goes off again when the lesson ends.
sonic.say.inPlaceOn: Fly by Sound is on, right where you are.
sonic.say.inPlaceIntro: You hear nearby walls and your height; {keys} says keys, {menu} opens lessons. {off} turns this off, {course} makes a course of gates.
sonic.say.inPlaceIntroCourse: You hear nearby walls and your height; the hum leads to the next gate. {off} turns this off, {keys} says the keys, {menu} opens the lessons.
sonic.say.momentKeys: Hear it again, key {again}, go on, key {on}. I know this sound, key {know}.
sonic.say.momentKnowOutside: Key {key} tells the game you know a new sound. It works when the game stops to show one.
sonic.say.helpKnow: Press key {key} when the game stops for a new sound you know already.
sonic.say.helpWhatSound: Press key {key} to hear what each sound playing now is.
sonic.say.tourNone: No sound plays right now. Fly near a wall or change height, then press key {key} again.
sonic.say.helpFlyUp: Space: up. Hold it to climb.
sonic.say.helpFlyDown: Shift: down. Hold it to descend and land.
sonic.say.helpFlyMove: W or the Up arrow: forward. S or the Down arrow: back.
sonic.say.helpFlySide: A and D: sideways, left and right.
sonic.say.helpFlyTurn: Left and Right arrows, or Q and E: turn on the spot.
sonic.say.helpFlyStop: Let go of all keys and the drone stops and hovers where it is.

sonic.keysList.more: In a lesson, press K to hear all the keys of the mode.
